signals.summary: Dramatic wilderness landscapes — glaciers, alpine passes, desert rock and northern lakes — shot wide and high-resolution.
signals.why_now: Ten-plus independent r/EarthPorn / r/travel landscapes within ~24h: 'The Wave, Arizona' (3h), 'Furka pass Switzerland' (7.4h), 'Banff, Canada' (9h), 'Kemijoki, Rovaniemi, Finland' (9.8h), 'Death Valley' (9.9h), 'Harvard Glacier, Alaska' (10.6h), 'Yosemite sub-alpine granite' (11.4h), 'Lake Manapouri, New Zealand' (15.1h) and 'Reykjadalur, Iceland' (18.2h).

signals.summary: A flood of amateur city photography — skylines, waterfronts and old quarters shot at golden hour — with Asian and European metros leading.
signals.why_now: Ten-plus independent r/CityPorn posts within ~18h: 'Shenzhen' (1.2h and 11.3h), 'Gold Coast, Australia' (2.8h), 'Binondo, Manila — world's oldest Chinatown' (2.8h), 'Toronto' (5.4h), 'Baku Boulevard' (7.1h), 'Budapest' (7.2h), 'Copenhagen' (11.6h), 'Osaka, Japan' (12.2h), 'Edinburgh' (15.3h) and 'Hamburg' (17.5h).

signals.summary: Trade and lifestyle press pushing unhurried, low-stimulation travel — cruises, ancient footpaths and off-grid nature retreats framed as an antidote to fast tourism.
signals.why_now: Four to five independent outlets within ~40h: 'When a slow trip can have great rewards' (10.2h), 'off-grid escapes in Southeast Asia for solitude' (14.2h), 'Oceania Cruises betting on slow travel' (35.3h), 'follow ancient footsteps... slow travel in Italy' (35.7h) and a 'Menty B breaks' travel piece (39.8h).
